title: RiskShield-PPO: Risk-Aware Safe Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Construction-Site Inspection under Perception Uncertainty
truthful_negative_results: PPO, SAC, and RiskShield-PPO achieved zero full-mission success.
One-step shielding outperformed k=3 on safety cost in the limited ablation.
The evidence is simulation-only and provides no real-world safety guarantee.
